$comment: Product manifest. store-setup/products-csv.mjs turns it into products.csv (Shopify product CSV import); scripts/store-setup.mjs --products then sets template suffix, sotocal.* metafields, unit price per kg and EN translations. Descriptions use only verified facts (brief §2). All prices are placeholders (1,00 €), every product is imported as draft and tagged preco-provisorio. The 2 × 1 kg pack is created in the Shopify Bundles app, not by CSV (see docs/ADMIN-SETUP.md). Product texts and compositions updated from the client leaflet (store-setup/apply-leaflet.py).

products.title: Lote Super Milano
products.body_html: 100% café. O Lote Super Milano junta finos e suaves cafés arábica de montanha com intensos robustas africanos. Desta seleção cuidadosa e de uma torra profissional resulta um café de sabor intenso e persistente, aroma agradavelmente suave e um expresso de creme aveludado e persistente.
products.seo_description: Lote Super Milano da Sotocal: arábicas de montanha e robustas africanos. Intenso e persistente, com creme aveludado. Torrado no Porto desde 1960.

en.title: Super Milano blend
en.body_html: 100% coffee. Super Milano brings together fine, smooth mountain Arabicas and intense African Robustas. Careful selection and a professional roast give an intense, lingering taste, a pleasantly soft aroma and an espresso with a velvety, lasting crema.

en.title: Reggio blend
en.body_html: 100% coffee. The most aromatic mountain coffees, combined with intense, strong coffees from African plantations, in an intense Italian-style roast. The result is an energetic, vigorous coffee with a strong flavour and a lively aroma: an invigorating espresso with a firm crema.

products.seo_description: Café descafeinado Sotocal: a mesma seleção de cafés e o mesmo cuidado na torra dos nossos lotes, mas sem cafeína. Torrado no Porto desde 1960.

products.title: Colorau
products.body_html: Também chamado pimentão doce ou paprica, o colorau obtém-se do fruto do pimenteiro doce, seco e moído. Realça a cor e intensifica o sabor dos cozinhados e entra na confeção de alguns enchidos.

en.title: Colorau (Portuguese paprika)
en.body_html: Also called sweet pepper or paprika, colorau is made from the fruit of the sweet pepper plant, dried and ground. It brings out the colour and deepens the flavour of cooked dishes, and is used in some cured sausages.

products.title: Pimenta
products.body_html: A pimenta branca e a pimenta preta vêm da mesma planta, a Piper nigrum. De sabor levemente picante, tem um uso quase universal na cozinha: carne, peixe, aves e molhos.

en.title: Pepper
en.body_html: White and black pepper come from the same plant, Piper nigrum. Slightly hot, it is used almost everywhere in the kitchen: meat, fish, poultry and sauces.

products.title: Piri-piri
products.body_html: O piri-piri, ou pimenta malagueta (Capsicum frutescens), usa-se seco para temperar e dar picante a muitos pratos, com destaque para o frango de churrasco e as caldeiradas de peixe e marisco.

en.title: Piri-piri
en.body_html: Piri-piri, or bird’s eye chilli (Capsicum frutescens), is used dried to season and add heat to many dishes, above all barbecued chicken and fish and seafood stews.

products.title: Canela
products.body_html: De aroma forte e quente e sabor levemente adocicado, a canela usa-se sobretudo em doces, mas também para aromatizar o leite ou até o café.

en.title: Cinnamon
en.body_html: With a strong, warm aroma and a slightly sweet taste, cinnamon is used mostly in desserts, but also to flavour milk or even coffee.

products.title: Cravinho
products.body_html: De aroma intenso e sabor forte e ardente, o cravinho usa-se em pratos doces e salgados, em marinadas de carne e caça, para temperar legumes e até para aromatizar licores e sangria.

en.title: Cloves
en.body_html: With an intense aroma and a strong, hot taste, cloves are used in sweet and savoury dishes, in marinades for meat and game, to season vegetables and even to flavour liqueurs and sangria.

products.title: Cominhos
products.body_html: Obtidos das sementes secas e moídas da planta Cuminum cyminum, os cominhos temperam pratos de carne, sobretudo de porco, e entram na confeção de enchidos.

en.title: Cumin
en.body_html: Made from the dried, ground seeds of Cuminum cyminum, cumin seasons meat dishes, especially pork, and is used in cured sausages.
